description: Implementation of ServiceAdministrator class managing service registration, instantiation, and library references within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: ServiceAdministrator
classes.description: Manages service registration, instantiation, and library lifecycle within the system.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a service with its metadata and factory.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a service based on its metadata and factory.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ServiceAdministrator.

methods.name: Instantiate
methods.description: Creates an instance of a service based on name, version, and interface number.

methods.name: ReleaseLibrary
methods.description: Releases a library reference, adding it to the unreferenced libraries list.

methods.name: FlushLibraries
methods.description: Clears all unreferenced libraries, allowing cleanup.
